decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY for rendering fidelity and Deck labels; changing the separate base logo does not obsolete its DJ-style attributes.
The back-panel design and font clause is already represented by a same-message MODIFY, while the bottom-logo redesign does not change the placard text or two-sided placement.
The rendering-based color direction is already captured by a same-message MODIFY; the separate logo redesign does not necessarily alter the established enclosure color attributes.
The logo treatment does not change the spout location, orientation, fabrication, or pour geometry.
Power-button accent lighting is already captured by a same-message MODIFY and is unaffected by the bottom-logo redesign.
The aesthetic logo decision does not change bowl capacity, form, or mixing-related size priorities.
Recreating the logo on the bottom of the separate base does not necessarily change the independently specified cursive K markings on the dispense buttons.
The source changes logo treatment and separately mentions lighting around the power button, but it does not change the master power control or its placement.
Placing a recreated logo on the separate base does not alter the required cup size or clearance height.
The logo placement uses the existing separate base but does not change its height, footprint alignment, or structural purpose.
The logo redesign does not change enclosure dimensions, accepted bulkiness, or accommodation of the bowl wells.
The visual logo treatment has no necessary effect on solenoid placement, dispensing actuation, isolation, or closed-state behavior.
